_comment: Subsystem modules for module-scoped audits (Development_Tools/ModuleMap/module_map.py). Pure-C# mod with no card JSON, so modules follow the code's own option groups (item locks, card size and capacity, containers, sorting, card marks and display, hotkeys, Repeat Action add-ons, character randomiser). Localization CSVs name no card, so their rows attribute to the mod-wide module. `module_map.py check UtilityBelt` must exit 0.

modules.name: Item Locks
modules.summary: Item lock: the per-save lock store, the run-start slot switch and prune, the EmptyInventory prefix, and LockApi, the seam Quick Transfer and Repeat Action call.

modules.name: Card Size and Capacity
modules.summary: Card Size row layouts, Extra Hand Slots and Extra Carry Weight, their CardSizePatch hooks, and the Show Carry Weight tooltip.

modules.name: Containers
modules.summary: Container Filter search box and its SetupInventory re-apply, equipped-container cycle/open hotkeys, and the sealed-container wax mark.

modules.name: Sorting
modules.summary: Sort an open container and Sort Hand Row / Sort Base Row hotkeys, sharing one sort cycle.

modules.name: Display and Accessibility
modules.summary: Card corner marks and the worn-tool mark, capacity and warmth readouts, clock format, Never Follow Cards, and Hide Rain And Snow Effects.

modules.name: Hotkeys and Equipment
modules.summary: Trash Card hotkey, Pin Blueprint and pinned blueprints, and Quickswap When Equipping.

modules.name: Repeat Action Add-ons
modules.summary: Auto-Pull Materials, Store Products In and Equip Spare Tool On Break, plus ModuleSeams, Utility Belt's side of Repeat Action's and Quick Transfer's public seams.

modules.name: Character Randomiser
modules.summary: The character-creation randomiser postfix on MainMenu.SetupCharacterCreationScreen.

modules.name: Mod-wide
modules.summary: Host plugin, the module registry, the overlay strings, project files and docs.
